title: 462 Stitches, Then He Went Back In

lines.text: A great white shark seized this man around the chest.
South Australia, 1963. A spearfishing championship at Aldinga Beach.
Rodney Fox was hunting fish with a speargun.
The jaws closed around him and wouldn't let go.
He reached for the shark's eyes. It released him.
Then it came back and seized his float.
He fought free of the line.
He was pulled out, barely alive.
It took four hundred and sixty-two stitches to close the wounds.
Fox still wanted to go back in the water.
Steel between him and the jaws.
From that cage, Ron Taylor filmed great whites underwater.
Some of the first footage of its kind.
He ran cage-diving trips for decades.
He co-founded a foundation to study and protect great whites.
The shark that nearly killed him turned him into its defender.

shots.description: Frame 1 is mid-story: looking UP from below — a lone spearfisher silhouetted at the bright, rippling surface, orange float beside him. From the bottom of frame a huge dark shark shape rises slowly into the light toward him. Shot ends just before contact.
shots.camera: Low angle from 6 m below, looking up, 24 mm; slow push-in starting on frame 1; shark enters bottom third
characters: fox_1963 (faceless stylised swimmer: black 1960s wetsuit, oval mask, J-snorkel, long fins, wooden speargun; NO tank)
white_shark (shark builder, ~4.5 m, grey back / white belly, stylised, no teeth shown open)
orange spearfishing float on a thin line tied to fox_1963's belt
shots.lighting: Bright surface caustics and sun shafts; shark in shadow until the last second

shots.description: Map card: South Australia coastline, Gulf St Vincent, pin drops at Aldinga Beach south of Adelaide. Then a sunny beach establishing beat: shallow reef, a few small boats, swimmers' floats dotting the water (competition).
shots.camera: 2D map push (first 1.8 s), then 35 mm wide from the water line, slight handheld
characters: competitors (char_figure silhouettes, distant)
shots.lighting: Midday summer sun, sky_gradient clear blue

shots.description: Close on the spearfisher at the surface: mask, a breath, then a duck-dive after a fish (reconstruction; breathing gear not asserted on screen).
shots.camera: Half-over/half-under split at the water line, 28 mm, follow the duck-dive
characters: fox_1963 (faceless stylised swimmer: black 1960s wetsuit, oval mask, J-snorkel, long fins, wooden speargun; NO tank)
orange spearfishing float on a thin line tied to fox_1963's belt

shots.description: Strike, implied only: side view, the diver gliding down toward the reef; the shark's silhouette fills the frame from the left and a single white flash covers the moment of contact. After the flash: only churned bubbles and silt where he was — no blood, no body detail.
shots.camera: Side-on 35 mm, whip pan with the shark; flash frame at contact, then hold on bubbles
characters: fox_1963 (faceless stylised swimmer: black 1960s wetsuit, oval mask, J-snorkel, long fins, wooden speargun; NO tank)
white_shark (shark builder, ~4.5 m, grey back / white belly, stylised, no teeth shown open)
shots.lighting: Blue daylight; flash frame pure white

shots.environment: other:abstract close-up — shark eye and silhouette hand
shots.description: Extreme close-up of the shark's dark, round eye (stylised black sphere, sheen) in blue water; a faceless silhouette hand reaches into frame toward it. Cut on the touch: the shark body peels away, and the diver silhouette tumbles free in a cloud of bubbles.
shots.camera: 50 mm macro on the eye, then quick pull-back 24 mm as the shark turns away
characters: white_shark (shark builder, ~4.5 m, grey back / white belly, stylised, no teeth shown open) (eye)
fox_1963 (faceless stylised swimmer: black 1960s wetsuit, oval mask, J-snorkel, long fins, wooden speargun; NO tank) (hand, then whole silhouette)
shots.lighting: Low-contrast blue; rim light on the eye

shots.description: From below: the orange float at the surface jerks and is dragged under by the shark's silhouette; the line snaps taut, angling down out of frame.
shots.camera: Low angle up at the surface, 24 mm, tilt down following the taut line
characters: white_shark (shark builder, ~4.5 m, grey back / white belly, stylised, no teeth shown open) (silhouette)
orange spearfishing float on a thin line tied to fox_1963's belt

shots.description: The line, taut, crossing frame; silhouette hands work at the knot at the belt; the line slips loose and whips away into the blue.

characters: fox_1963 (faceless stylised swimmer: black 1960s wetsuit, oval mask, J-snorkel, long fins, wooden speargun; NO tank) (hands and belt only)

shots.description: Surface, above water: a small wooden dinghy (simple boat prop, 4 m) reaches the floating figure; two faceless silhouettes haul him over the gunwale. Wide, no detail of injuries; the figure is a dark shape.
shots.camera: 35 mm from the water line, slight handheld, boat moves left to right
characters: fox_1963 (faceless stylised swimmer: black 1960s wetsuit, oval mask, J-snorkel, long fins, wooden speargun; NO tank)
rescuers x2 (char_figure silhouettes, 1960s clothing)
shots.lighting: Sun now behind cloud: desaturated, flat light

shots.description: Black background, white line-art outline of a human torso (front view, no flesh, no skin). Rib lines on the left side flicker red one by one; the left lung outline deflates. Purely schematic.
characters: generic body outline (diagram, faceless)
shots.lighting: Flat diagram, white lines, red accent

shots.description: Same outline: a dotted stitch line draws across the chest and arm as short white tick marks (like a sewing pattern), while a counter climbs to 462.
shots.camera: Static, slow push; counter stops with a small shake
characters: generic body outline (diagram)

shots.description: Mid-turn: the same reef water as S03, empty and calm. A faceless figure stands waist-deep at the water's edge, looking out (seen from behind).
shots.camera: 35 mm from behind the figure at the shoreline, slow push
characters: fox_later (faceless figure, from behind)

shots.description: A steel cage frame (see S13 prop) swings off a small boat's davit and drops into the water with a splash; camera dips under the surface to see it sink and settle on its line.
shots.camera: Half-over/half-under at the water line, 28 mm, dip under as it lands
characters: boat crew (char_figure silhouettes)
shots.lighting: Late-afternoon warm sun above, blue below

shots.description: Underwater: a simple two-person cage (new prop: 2 x 1.2 x 1.8 m box frame of steel cylinders, bars 0.25 m apart, top hatch, float drums on top) hangs from a surface line. A diver inside — now on scuba (single tank) — grips the bars. A great white glides past outside the bars.
shots.camera: Inside the cage looking out through the bars, 24 mm; shark crosses frame left to right
characters: fox_later (stylised diver, single tank, faceless)
white_shark (shark builder, ~4.5 m, grey back / white belly, stylised, no teeth shown open)
shots.lighting: Blue-green daylight, god rays through the bars

shots.description: A second diver (faceless, holding a boxy 1960s film camera in an underwater housing) films through the cage bars as a great white approaches.
